title: TRACE FORUM 2027
description: TRACE FORUM brings together the people shaping Africa's agricultural and resource value chains to build a future where what we produce can be traced, financed, protected, traded and fairly valued.
aboutImageAlt: A farm worker carrying a crate through a green field
aboutDescription: The sovereign entities that shape Africa’s compliance narrative will dictate the terms of trade for cocoa, coffee, rubber, and timber over the next half-century. TRACE FORUM is the continental podium where African producers assert market sovereignty. reasonConnectDescription: Every African country affected by the EUDR will have a voice in this room. Policymakers, commodity boards, farmer associations, and geospatial technology pioneers from 20 nations – assembled together, for the first time, in the heart of the Congo Basin.
reasonComplyDescription: From sub-meter GPS farm boundary mapping to verifiable batch QR codes and automated Due Diligence Statements (DDS) – TRACE FORUM delivers the executable technical frameworks, data vaults, and live audit simulations required before the border.
